system: Synchronisation centrale — Outbox (DomainEvent) + Pusher/Soketi broadcast + per-surface polling/delta reconciliation + 4 re-queue cron lanes (rescue / monitor / retry-failed / prune) + DLQ. HEAD 8db38d801.
head: 8db38d80195d945d01d6265b3d915a01195341c3
precondition: All findings below assume the V1 prod async queue topology documented in scripts/deploy/supervisor.conf.template:42 — `queue:work redis --queue=high,default --tries=3 --timeout=120` (SIGALRM hard-timeout). Under QUEUE_CONNECTION=sync (tests/CI default, config/queue.php:16) the failure modes are inline/different and the orphan class does not arise.

verified_findings.title: Clean first-attempt-crash orphan (dispatched_at SET + last_error NULL + attempts>=5) falls through EVERY re-queue lane AND the orphan alarm — never broadcast, silently pruned at 90d
verified_findings.grep_evidence: VERIFIED at HEAD. (1) Phase-1 claim DispatchDomainEventsJob.php:80-83 sets dispatched_at=now + attempts++ but does NOT write last_error. (2) A worker hard-killed at the broadcast DispatchDomainEventsJob.php:116 before the Phase-3b catch (:156-166) runs leaves dispatched_at SET, attempts=N, last_error=NULL — schema-IDENTICAL to a Phase-3a success (:153-155 keeps dispatched_at, clears last_error; there is no positive 'broadcast succeeded' marker, only absence of error). LOAD-BEARING LINK (why last_error never gets set): the same crashed job instance's native Laravel retry re-enters Phase 1, hits the guard `if ($domainEvent->dispatched_at !== null) { $skip=true; return; }` (:75-78) then early-returns with only Log::info, NO throw (:88-94) — so no single job instance ever reaches a final-try FAILURE, hence failed() (:193-214, which WOULD write last_error) never fires. supervisor --tries=3 (supervisor.conf.template:42) overriding $tries=6 (DispatchDomainEventsJob.php:42) does NOT rescue this: the extra native retries all skip-return. (3) outbox:rescue lane-B (OutboxRescueCommand.php:42-47) re-drives it (whereNotNull dispatched_at AND dispatched_at<now-10min AND attempts<5; NO last_error filter), nulling dispatched_at (:60) and dispatching a fresh job (:64) whose Phase-1 ++attempts again leaves last_error NULL. ~4-5 cycles -> attempts reaches 5. (4) Now matches NOTHING: rescue lane-B excludes (attempts<5 :47); retry-failed excludes (DomainEvent.php:45-48 scopeFailed->scopePending->whereNull(dispatched_at) :34-37 — row is CLAIMED); monitor staleCount excludes (whereNull dispatched_at MonitorOutboxStaleness.php:44-47); monitor ORPHAN alarm excludes because it REQUIRES whereNotNull('last_error') (MonitorOutboxStaleness.php:74). (5) PruneOutboxCommand.php:53-54 DELETES it at 90d (dispatched_at NOT NULL AND < cutoff). UNTESTED VARIANT confirmed: every case in tests/Feature/Outbox/OutboxMonitorCrashClaimedSentinelTest.php seeds last_error SET on the alarm-positive case (:44, :107) or last_error=NULL only on success/false-positive cases that expect NO alarm (:64); the last_error=NULL + attempts>=5 + dispatched_at SET orphan is not exercised. Test docstring (:31-34) itself states the schema-identity trade-off that creates this blind spot. Severity P2 not P1: order-bearing surfaces self-heal — KdsSyncService.php:96-98 cursors on orders.updated_at (authoritative orders table, NOT domain_events) and PosOrdersTrackerComponent.vue:747-758 fetchOrders() is a full reload (this.orders = data) polled at :720 — so a lost order broadcast reconciles on the next poll; lasting impact is a violated at-least-once guarantee + silent loss of the outbox row for replay/forensic, and (for catalog/availability/settings which have no periodic poll) a stale kiosk menu until WS reconnect.
verified_findings.recommendation: Add a distinct positive success marker — a `broadcast_completed_at` (or `succeeded_at`) column set in Phase-3a (DispatchDomainEventsJob.php:153). Then (a) the orphan alarm becomes `dispatched_at NOT NULL AND broadcast_completed_at NULL AND dispatched_at < orphanCutoff` (catches BOTH last_error-NULL and last_error-SET orphans, zero false-positives), and (b) prune's safe-set switches from `dispatched_at NOT NULL` to `broadcast_completed_at NOT NULL` so it can never delete an un-broadcast orphan. Add a sentinel seeding the last_error=NULL + attempts>=5 + dispatched_at SET orphan and asserting the monitor pages. No schema change is the wrong path here — widening the existing query to catch last_error-NULL orphans would false-positive on every successful dispatch (success and clean-orphan are schema-identical without the marker).

verified_findings.title: Empty Pusher client_options (no Guzzle connect/read timeout) makes a network black-hole HANG the broadcast instead of THROW — which is what produces the last_error-NULL orphan class as the default Pusher-outage failure mode
verified_findings.grep_evidence: VERIFIED at HEAD. config/broadcasting.php:58-60 — the `pusher` connection's `client_options` array is EMPTY (only a Guzzle-docs comment, no `connect_timeout`/`timeout`). DispatchDomainEventsJob.php:116 `$broadcaster->broadcast(...)` has no surrounding time guard. With no timeout, a black-holed TCP connection (SYN dropped, no RST) blocks the HTTP call indefinitely until the supervisor `--timeout=120` SIGALRM (supervisor.conf.template:42) hard-kills the worker mid-broadcast — which does NOT run Phase-3b's catch (DispatchDomainEventsJob.php:156-166), so last_error stays NULL and dispatched_at stays SET = the orphan class of the linked P2 finding. OutboxRescueCommand.php:30-31 comment already acknowledges 'no explicit HTTP timeout in config/broadcasting.php'. NOT a double-broadcast bug — the lockForUpdate claim guard (DispatchDomainEventsJob.php:65-86) holds; rescue lane-B's extra broadcast is documented as advisory (:56-58). With a timeout configured, a dead Pusher would instead THROW (ConnectException) -> Phase-3b catch writes last_error + nulls dispatched_at -> row lands in the pending/failed lane the monitor and retry-failed CAN see.
verified_findings.recommendation: Set explicit Guzzle timeouts in config/broadcasting.php:58 client_options (e.g. 'timeout' => 5, 'connect_timeout' => 3) so a dead broadcaster throws within seconds (caught by Phase-3b, surfaced via last_error + the orphan-free pending lane) instead of hanging until SIGALRM. SECONDARY (config-only, no frozen-zone): reconcile supervisor --timeout=120 (supervisor.conf.template:42) vs queue retry_after=90 (config/queue.php:41/49/69) — timeout(120) > retry_after(90) is inverted from Laravel's documented requirement (retry_after MUST exceed timeout); the claim guard absorbs the resulting DB race but the ordering is wrong. Also note supervisor --tries=3 (supervisor.conf.template:42) overrides the job's documented $tries=6 (DispatchDomainEventsJob.php:42) backoff curve [1,5,15,60,300], truncating it to 2 retries.

verified_findings.title: Contract-violation fail-once intent is quietly defeated by outbox:rescue lane A re-driving the row up to the prune-eligibility attempt cap
verified_findings.grep_evidence: VERIFIED at HEAD. On a PayloadMismatchException, Phase-3b runs: DispatchDomainEventsJob.php:161-166 forceFill sets dispatched_at=NULL + last_error='contract_violation: ...', THEN :184 `$this->fail($e)` short-circuits the queue retry curve so the job lands in failed_jobs once (fail-once intent satisfied for the QUEUE lane; tests/Feature/Sentinels/PayloadMismatchFailOnceSentinelTest.php reasons only about this single-job lifecycle). BUT because dispatched_at was nulled, outbox:rescue lane A (OutboxRescueCommand.php:39-41: whereNull('dispatched_at') AND created_at < now-2min AND attempts<5, run everyMinute Kernel.php:40-41) re-selects the row and re-dispatches a fresh DispatchDomainEventsJob (:64), which fails the contract check again and fail()s again — repeating until attempts hits rescue's <5 cap (~4-5 re-drives). The malformed payload then becomes eligible for OutboxRetryFailedCommand which selects failed(5) AND attempts<REPLAY_MAX_ATTEMPTS=12 (OutboxRetryFailedCommand.php:67,102-104) — but that lane is scopeFailed->pending->whereNull(dispatched_at), and a contract-violation row HAS dispatched_at=NULL, so it ALSO re-drives it (attempts 5->12) before prune (attempts>=6) reclaims it. Net: a permanently-malformed payload generates roughly a dozen re-dispatches + failed_jobs rows + audit-noise lines, defeating the documented fail-once intent (:175-186).
verified_findings.recommendation: For PayloadMismatchException specifically (a permanent, never-replayable error), do NOT null dispatched_at in Phase-3b — either keep dispatched_at SET so rescue lane A's whereNull filter and retry-failed's scopePending exclude it, OR add a terminal marker (e.g. exclude `last_error LIKE 'contract_violation:%'`) to both rescue lane A and retry-failed so permanently-bad rows are not re-driven. Verify with a sentinel that runs the contract-violation job THEN invokes foodking:outbox:rescue (and foodking:outbox:retry-failed) and asserts the row is dispatched at most once.

verified_findings.title: Outbox-swallow pager alarm covers only the 5 ORDER listeners; the 8 catalog/availability/settings/branch-status/coupon/order-table listeners degrade to a plain Log::warning with no pager signal — and the catalog/availability/settings surfaces have NO polling backstop
verified_findings.grep_evidence: VERIFIED at HEAD. grep `OutboxBroadcastSwallowedEvent` across app/Listeners: fired by exactly 5 listeners — PersistOrderCreatedToOutbox (event() at :89), PersistOrderStatusChangedToOutbox, PersistOrderPaidAtCounterToOutbox, PersistOrderPaymentStatusChangedToOutbox, PersistKdsOrderRecalledToOutbox. The other 8 Persist*ToOutbox listeners do NOT fire it: PersistCatalogChangedToOutbox (catch at :112-123 does only Log::warning, no typed event), PersistItemAvailabilityChangedToOutbox, PersistItemExtraAvailabilityChangedToOutbox, PersistItemVariationAvailabilityChangedToOutbox, PersistSettingsUpdatedToOutbox, PersistBranchStatusChangedToOutbox, PersistCouponChangedToOutbox, AND PersistOrderTableChangedToOutbox (8th — missed by the raw enumeration). The typed event is what EscalateOutboxBroadcastSwallowed.php:44 turns into Log::channel('fiscal')->critical('[Outbox] broadcast swallowed', severity=pager_grade) — the line a nightly ops grep keys on; a plain Log::warning never reaches it. Coverage asymmetry confirmed: the surfaces WITHOUT the pager alarm (catalog/availability/settings) are ALSO the weakest-backstop surfaces — KioskAppComponent.vue refetches the menu (kioskMenu/fetchMenu force:true) ONLY inside the WS 'connected' reconnect handler (_onWsReconnect / window._wsService.on('connected')); the 15000ms setInterval near :347 is the OFFLINE order-sync queue (startAutoSync + getPendingCount), NOT a menu poll. So a swallowed CatalogChanged on a kiosk whose WS never drops = stale menu / sold-out item still orderable until reconnect, with NO pager.
verified_findings.recommendation: Primary (NOT frozen — locus is the listener files): fire OutboxBroadcastSwallowedEvent from the non-order listeners' afterCommit catch blocks, or DRY it by centralizing the afterCommit dispatch+swallow-escalation into one shared helper/trait that all 13 listeners call (PersistCatalogChangedToOutbox.php:101-125 is one of 13 near-identical try/catch blocks). The 'no polling backstop' danger applies to the 7 catalog/availability/settings/branch-status/coupon listeners; the 8th (PersistOrderTableChanged) is an order surface that self-heals via POS/KDS polling. SECONDARY mitigation (FROZEN-ZONE — KioskAppComponent.vue is CLAUDE.md §7, requires a LOCK before editing): add a low-frequency catalog/availability poll or snapshot-version check on the kiosk so a missed CatalogChanged self-heals without requiring a WS reconnect.
